title: Astigmatism
description: This episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks untangles astigmatism, the refractive state where the eye has no single point of focus. The Guide walks through a cornea curved more like a spoon than a sphere, where every image arrives gently stretched in one direction. The Host carries the lived experience, from print that leans like a crooked picture frame to headlights that grow tails after dark. Listeners leave with the Greek roots of the term, one honest myth retired, and a clear sense of why this shape is so common.
